This week's activity for Adele Fiona Boone, an Electrical Engineer, has triggered two rules. The most significant evidence is the unusual volume of logons outside her working hours (4), which is clearly above her usual range and even exceeds that of her peers. Additionally, she visited job-search sites 70 times, a stark increase from her typical behavior and far beyond what her peers in the same role experienced this week.

Overall, these findings suggest that Boone's activity this week deviates significantly from her normal patterns and those of her colleagues.
